x, y, n = map(int, input().split())

def abs_value(val):
    return -val if val < 0 else val

best_num = 0
best_den = 1
best_diff = 1e15
target = x / y

for denom in range(1, n + 1):
    left_bound = 0
    right_bound = 1000000000
    while right_bound - left_bound > 10:
        m1 = left_bound + (right_bound - left_bound) // 3
        m2 = right_bound - (right_bound - left_bound) // 3
        diff1 = abs_value(target - m1 / denom)
        diff2 = abs_value(target - m2 / denom)
        if diff1 > diff2:
            left_bound = m1
        else:
            right_bound = m2
    for i in range(left_bound, right_bound + 4):
        current_diff = abs_value(target - i / denom)
        if current_diff < best_diff - 1e-15:
            best_diff = current_diff
            best_num = i
            best_den = denom

print(f"{best_num}/{best_den}")
